verdicts.reason: The two layouts are nearly identical, and both have the same problems. 'Every mixed case.' is pushed into a cramped bottom-left corner as three one-word lines at about CTA weight, so it competes with the button. The legal line is shrunk to an illegible size and jammed under the button against the bottom edge. The big empty circle with the shoe low inside it leaves a dead middle while the bottom is overcrowded. B wins only on a small point: 'WEEKEND ONLY' sits closer to '20% off', so the eyebrow reads as part of the headline group as it does in the original. A floats it higher, away from the headline.
